authorization_basis: Explicit user approval to prepare Amendment 002 for truth isolation and production-harness implementation; canonical execution and scoring remain prohibited.

production_harness_contract.execution_gate: A future separately frozen, independently validated canonical execution authorization is mandatory before launching any actual comparator command.
production_harness_contract.failure_continuation_policy: Continue after classified comparator completion failures. Stop on infrastructure, integrity or authorization failures; preserve partial records without a false completion manifest.
production_harness_contract.preauthorization_behavior: Production comparator dispatch must fail closed. Synthetic fixtures and explicitly allowlisted mock executors alone may be exercised.
production_harness_contract.provenance_policy: Create durable, non-overwriting per-invocation execution records, output checksums, explicit failure classifications and a completion manifest only after all scheduled invocations are accounted for.
production_harness_contract.rerun_policy: No automatic comparator reruns. Any subsequent attempt requires separately recorded authorization.
production_harness_contract.resource_policy: Record wall time and fresh-worker Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN.ru_maxrss in KiB and bytes; identify the measurement as maximum child RSS, not concurrent process-tree aggregate RSS.
production_harness_contract.runner_policy: Use the existing frozen runner for command construction, subprocess execution and native-output normalization. Do not modify frozen runner code.
production_harness_contract.scoring_policy: Execution and native-output normalization remain separate from truth-based scientific scoring.
production_harness_contract.worker_policy: A fresh isolated worker is required for every invocation.

supersession_explanation: The original host-root read-only bind permits reading the entire host filesystem. For production-shaped comparator isolation, replace that mount layout with a private filesystem root and explicitly verified mounts. The original sandbox remains frozen historically; existing synthetic validation interfaces may be retained while the replacement is developed.

truth_isolation_contract.descriptor_policy: Close unintended inherited file descriptors, prohibit inherited truth descriptors, and validate /proc and process-namespace isolation against descriptor-based and process-root access paths.
truth_isolation_contract.environment_policy: Supply a strict environment allowlist. No truth path, secret, unapproved loader path or unvalidated runtime search path may enter the child environment.
truth_isolation_contract.filesystem_policy: Use an empty private mount root. Bind only independently validated operating-system dependencies, pinned runtime dependencies, the single permitted input view and the designated invocation workspace.
truth_isolation_contract.input_policy: Expose only the permitted per-invocation input view. Do not bind the canonical dataset parent, truth directory, event ledger, scoring data or another scenario's inputs.
truth_isolation_contract.namespace_policy: Disable networking, isolate process IDs and construct a private /proc view without host process visibility.
truth_isolation_contract.path_policy: Reject symlink escapes, path traversal, noncanonical paths, mount destination collisions, unsafe ancestor mounts and changes to validated source paths. Recheck at the execution boundary; fail closed if path stability cannot be established.
truth_isolation_contract.required_failure_behavior: Any successful synthetic truth read or isolation uncertainty fails validation and blocks execution authorization.
truth_isolation_contract.runtime_dependency_policy: Resolve executable, interpreter, shared-library, environment and runtime-data dependencies before authorization. Verify mount sources, canonical destinations, expected identities and truth-disjointness. Do not accept arbitrary user-supplied read-only mount roots.
truth_isolation_contract.test_dataset_policy: Use synthetic public inputs and private synthetic truth sentinels only. Never inspect canonical truth to conduct the isolation test.
